title: Attack-Label-Free Threshold Calibration and Label Efficiency in One-Class SCADA Anomaly Detection: Code and Processed Results
description: Version 2.0.0 code, configurations, processed results, representative score arrays, and figures for a reproducible cross-domain benchmark of one-class SCADA anomaly detection. The corrected protocol separates chronological detector fitting from held-out normal-only threshold calibration, audits attack-label budgets using temporal blocks without attack-labelled threshold tuning, and compares chronological with matched stratified-random splitting on BATADAL, Gas Pipeline, and HAI 22.04. Raw third-party datasets are not redistributed.
